comparison.objective: Release a complete kit while withholding a short kit rather than topping it up.
comparison.physical_skill: Inspect kit completeness and make a conditional release/hold decision.
comparison.success_condition: Complete kit released and short kit held without adding missing items; detailed kit contents and scoring are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Conditional completeness inspection and routing do not test physical fracture, precision hammering, retained insert integrity, or free-fragment containment.
